_note: Hallasan content. Stage coordinates are metres: x runs 0..width left to right, z runs -depth/2 (far, into the scene) .. +depth/2 (near the camera). Start positions are [x, z]. The walkable stage is surrounded by a non-walkable ground apron: 'sides' metres on the left, right and near edges, 'far' metres on the far edge (the backdrop, see 'backdrop', stands beyond it). Props: density per 100 m2 of ground (walkable + apron) and a fixed random seed.
name: 한라산

walk_limit._note: How far toward the camera a traveler may walk. The camera never shows ground past the near edge of the apron (it stops short of it where the ground rises toward the side of the view), so the bottom of the screen at a traveler's column is the near edge pulled back by that rise; the feet may reach it minus 'near_margin' metres (along z). The limit therefore depends on x. The far and side limits stay at the stage edge.

prop_fade._note: Trees, rocks and other props between the camera and a traveler fade to 'opacity' (0..1) over 'time' seconds, and fade back when they no longer cover one.

tooltip._note: The plant hover name stays solid for 'steady_time' seconds, then flickers for 'flicker_time' seconds at 'flicker_rate' visible/hidden changes per second, then is gone. It returns only after the mouse leaves the plant and enters a plant again, or the controlled traveler walks into reach of a plant (the same timings). Deliberately short: the game should not be easy.

discovery._note: A target kind joins the discovery list when a traveler comes within 'radius' metres (horizontal) of any plant of that kind. 'fade_time' seconds is the fade-in of a new entry.

picking._note: Click a plant and the controlled traveler walks to it and picks its letter once within 'pick_radius' metres (horizontal). A walk that gets no closer for 'walk_stuck_timeout' seconds is cancelled. A decoy's letter vanishes in a steam puff of 'steam_duration' seconds and colour 'steam_color' (r, g, b).

reach_ring._note: A faint ground ring around the nearest pickable plant within 'pick_radius' of the controlled traveler. Same look for targets and decoys. Radius = pick_radius + 'radius_offset' metres, 'width' metres thick, colour r, g, b with 'alpha' (0..1) pulsing down by 'pulse_depth' (0..1 of alpha) at 'pulse_speed' cycles per second.

basket_hud._note: The 망태기 HUD at the bottom right: a woven bag of letter tiles. Tiles wrap into rows of at most 'max_columns'; 'tile_size', 'tile_gap' and 'margin' are in pixels; colours are r, g, b.

spelling_view._note: The spelling view, opened by clicking a discovery entry. 'panel_size' [w, h] and 'panel_top' (distance from the top of the screen) are in pixels, the panel centred across; 'block_size' [w, h] is one syllable block, 'block_gap' the space between blocks, 'slot_gap' the space between a block's slots and its edge; 'failure_flash_color' (r, g, b) shows on a failed block for 'failure_flash_time' seconds before the view closes; 'correct_color' tints a locked block; 'done_color' is the mark and tint of a finished entry in the discovery list.

keyboard_select._note: The red highlight on the basket tile the keyboard cursor is on, while the spelling view is open. Colours are r, g, b, a. 'outline_width' is the solid border and 'halo_width' the softer glow outside it, both in pixels; the halo fades outward. 'pulse_speed' is pulses per second and 'pulse_depth' (0..1) how much the halo dims at the low point of the pulse.

damage._note: What a failed spelling syllable costs. 'failure_damage_units' is in half-units (1 = half a heart) and hits BOTH travelers. Placeholder.

gore_placeholder._note: Placeholder blood on the travelers (never plants or animals) until the art pass. 'burst_duration' seconds of spray; the second traveler's burst starts 'stagger' seconds after the first; 'tint_color' flashes on a hit traveler's body for 'tint_duration' seconds; 'death_beat' seconds pass between a death and the scene restart while the screen dims to 'death_dim_alpha' black.

decoy_rewards._note: What a reward decoy (노루귀, 들쭉나무) gives when picked: one entry rolled by weight (chance = weight / total), 'count' of that item into the backpack. Every item must exist in items.json, weight > 0, count >= 1. PLACEHOLDER weights. spelling_hint and slow_time_charm are not in the table yet. 'floating_label' is the text that rises from the picked plant: it rises 'rise' m and fades over 'seconds'; 'font_size' is Label3D pixels, 'pixel_size' metres per pixel, colour r, g, b; 'render_priority' (Label3D sort order among transparent things, above the steam puff's 0) keeps it drawn in front of the steam.

decoy_gore._note: The gore beat on the traveler who picked a harm decoy (travelers only, never the plant, never an animal). Every decoy kind names exactly one entry here in its 'gore' field; the beat is that kind's, whatever the outcome roll was. 'duration' is the whole beat in seconds, 'pop_seconds' (>0, <= duration) when it pops; the beat gates picks, the spelling view, both menus and walking, and pauses the stuck countdown and its music. A lethal pick's death sequence starts on the tick after the beat ends. Colours are r, g, b. PLACEHOLDER numbers and shapes. 'caption_ko' (optional, a non-empty string) is shown above the picker for the whole beat, in front of steam and particles, in the style of 'caption_style' (font_size Label3D pixels, pixel_size metres per pixel, height metres above the feet, colour r, g, b, render_priority); 'show_captions' false turns every caption off. face_swell_pop: a head blob (radius 'head_radius' m at 'head_height' m) swells to 'swell_scale' times, reddening from 'head_color' to 'swollen_color' and shaking by 'shake_amplitude' m at 'shake_hz', then pops into a blood burst of 'pop_blood_strength' (1 = the normal hit) and 'pop_chunks' flesh chunks. convulse_eyes_pop: the traveler jitters by 'jitter_amplitude' m (and tilts 'tilt_degrees') at 'jitter_hz' until 'pop_seconds', then two eyes (radius 'eye_radius', 'eye_color') with a 'tail_color' tail 'tail_length' m long fly out sideways ('eye_speed_side' m/s), up ('eye_speed_up') and toward the camera ('eye_speed_toward') and fall under 'gravity', with a blood burst of 'pop_blood_strength' at the head. deer_ears_rip: two furry ears ('ear_length', 'ear_width' m, 'ear_color', lighter 'ear_inner_color') grow out of the sides of the head (at 'head_height', 'head_radius' m from the middle) during the first 'grow_fraction' of the build-up, lean outward by 'ear_tilt_degrees', twitch ('twitch_degrees' at 'twitch_hz') and swivel by 'swivel_degrees' toward something offscreen; at the pop each ear tears off in a blood burst of 'pop_blood_strength' and hops away ('hop_speed' m/s, hops of 'hop_height' m under 'gravity') toward the nearest edge of the walkable map, vanishing 'hop_seconds' after the pop. deulssuk_drunk: until the pop the traveler wobbles ('wobble_degrees' at 'wobble_hz') and staggers once round a circle of 'stagger_radius' m that starts and ends where it stands (shrunk, or none, where props or the walk limits are in the way), with 'hiccups' bobs of 'hiccup_height' m lasting 'hiccup_seconds' each; at the pop a fountain of 'fountain_particles' droplets ('fountain_color', 'fountain_size' m) arcs out of the mouth ('fountain_speed' m/s, aimed up and toward the camera in the ratio 'fountain_lift' : 'fountain_forward', under 'gravity') for 'fountain_seconds', and a puddle of 'puddle_radius' m ('puddle_color') spreads where it lands and fades out over the last 'puddle_fade' seconds.

hearts_hud._note: The heart readout at the top right, one row per traveler. 'heart_size', 'gap' and 'margin' are pixels; a half heart is half filled, an empty one only an outline.

spares._note: Every completed word earns one credit (once). A completion that leaves a jamo short spends its own credit at once on a spare plant of that word's kind, carrying the jamo the unfinished words are most short of; otherwise the credit is banked. A failed syllable spends the oldest banked credits, one spare each, while a shortage is left. Credits banked plus spares spawned never pass 'cap'. 'grow_seconds' is the grow-in (scale 0 to 1), during which the spare cannot be picked. 'slots' maps a word (target kind) id to the fixed [x, z] where its spare appears, in the word's own zone: at least 2 m from every plant and slot, 4 m from other plants of its kind, 6 m from the starts, clear of props. Slots are invisible until used. Positions come from a one-off script, as the first 36 plants did.

decoy_placement._note: Where the decoys stand, how many there are, which kind each is and what it does. Nothing here is fixed: at every scene start the placement RNG rolls, in this order, (1) the number of decoys, uniform over 'count_min'..'count_max' inclusive; (2) that many DISTINCT slots, uniformly, from the ONE shared 'slots' list (any kind may use any slot; zones play no part); then for each decoy in turn (3) its kind by 'kind_weights', (4) its outcome by 'outcome_weights' (harm or reward, independent of the kind) and (5) its letter, uniformly from the jamo of the target words (derived from the words, not listed here). One --placement-seed=N therefore fixes all of it. A harm outcome costs the picker 'damage_units' half-units (1 = half a heart) and plays the kind's gore (foraging.decoy_gore); a reward outcome rolls foraging.decoy_rewards. The outcome is hidden until the pick. 'slots' are [x, z], each on the stage 'edge_margin' m from its edges, at least 'any_min' m from every target plant and spare slot and from every other slot, 'scenery_min' m from every tree and 'start_min' m from the travelers' starts; props are kept 2.6 m (centre to centre) from every slot, see foraging.gd. The slots are the 24 verified slots of the four old per-kind pools (none dropped: the closest pair is 2.56 m apart), generated by tools/generate_slots.gd. 'count_max' may not pass the number of slots. Tries are bounded by 'max_retries'; when they run out, or when this block is bad, the decoys stand where foraging.plants.placed puts them (the fallback: those kinds and letters, outcomes still rolled). PLACEHOLDER numbers.

chaos_piles._note: Rare DDEOK piles lying on the ground, no letter, no name. At every scene start 'count_table' draws how many appear (weighted, 0 allowed), they stand on that many of 'slots' chosen uniformly, and 'amount_table' draws each one's DDEOK (weighted). PLACEHOLDER numbers. Entries are {count | amount, weight}: weights whole numbers above 0, amounts at least 1, counts at least 0; the slots must cover the largest count. Slots: [x, z], each at least 'min_plant' m from every target plant, spare slot and decoy slot (so from any decoy layout), 'min_start' m from the starts, 2.5 m from every tree and inside the walkable stage; every zone has one; at least off_path.min_slots are 'off_path.distance' m from every target plant. Piles are at least 'min_pile' m apart. Picking one puts its amount into the backpack as 'item'.

stuck._note: When no sequence of correct words can finish the scene any more (and nobody is dead), a countdown of 'countdown_seconds' starts; the monster comes at 0. The last 'lockout_seconds' cannot be cancelled and reject every input. 'number_alpha' is the opacity of the seconds number at the top centre ('number_margin' px from the top); the edge vignette reaches 'vignette_strength' opacity at 0 s and grows as (time spent / countdown) to the power 'vignette_growth'. Placeholder.

stuck_music._note: PLACEHOLDER countdown music, generated in code (no audio files): two detuned drone tones ('drone_hz', 'drone_level') and sparse gong-like hits ('hit_hz', 'hit_volume' relative to the drone, gaps drawn from 'hit_interval_min'..'hit_interval_max' seconds). Starts at 'volume_db', fading in over 'fade_seconds'; one loop is 'loop_seconds' long. Never tuned by ear.

monster._note: The legendary monster that kills both travelers when the stuck countdown runs out. Hallasan: a white deer (the legend's folklore details are unverified, none are claimed). It leaps in from just off the left screen edge over 'leap_seconds', lands 'standoff' m left of the first traveler (the leftmost) and hits it, 'hit_gap_seconds' later the second, and 'aftermath_seconds' after that the death beat starts. Each hit sprays 'burst_strength' times the normal gore, flashes the traveler red for 'tint_seconds' and throws it 'knock_distance' m, tipped over 'knock_tilt_degrees', in 'knock_seconds'. Colours are r, g, b. Placeholder shapes.
monster.name: White deer

word_rewards._note: What finishing a target word gives: 'word_reward_count' of the word's plant item go into Fernanda's backpack, and "+2 고사리" (the count and the item's name_ko) floats up from the traveler who spelled it, in the decoy_rewards floating_label style. 'item_by_word' maps each target kind id (foraging.plants.kinds) to an item id in items.json. 'label_height' is how many metres above the traveler's feet the label starts.

backpack_hud._note: Fernanda's backpack panel (Tab, or right Shift / right Ctrl). 'position' and 'size' are the panel's top-left corner and size in pixels; colours are r, g, b and 'panel_alpha' is the panel's opacity; font sizes are pixels. Rows list GameState.inventory; description text is the smaller, muted colour.
backpack_hud.title: Fernanda's backpack
backpack_hud._note_select: Elixir rows can be selected (mouse click, or the players' movement keys and Space / Enter) and drunk. 'row_padding' is the space inside a row in pixels. A selected row uses selected_row_color with a selected_border_width-pixel border. The choice panel asks who drinks: '{item}' is the item's name, '{name}' the traveler, '{hearts}' their hearts as hearts_text ('{hearts}' / '{max}', halves shown as .5). The message line after a drink stays message_seconds; {who}, {item}, {healed} and {wasted} are filled in, amounts are in hearts ('half_glyph' is the half).

pause_menu.confirm_text: Restart? Progress in this scene is lost.

terrain._note: Ground height in metres as a function of x: [x, height] points joined by a smooth monotone curve, flat beyond the first and last point. The ground is flat across z. Max slope must stay under 30 degrees.

backdrop._note: The ridge and hills behind the far apron. 'depth' is how far the backdrop reaches behind the far apron (z runs from the far apron edge to -depth beyond it). Each piece sits at base height = terrain height at its x + offset (metres); 'sink' extends a box that far below its base so the ground never shows under it. shape box: size [width, height, depth]; shape cone: size [radius, height], stretch_x widens it along x. x and z are the piece centre.

plants._note: 10 kinds. The 28 target plants are fixed here, one entry in 'placed' each: kind id, x, z (y comes from the terrain) and the single letter it carries. A target kind has one plant per letter of its name (repeats count: 미나리 has two ㅣ plants), so every letter plant of a word is needed. Target positions are fixed, never random, and the letters of a word are not in word order along x. The four decoy kinds (kind 'decoy') have no fixed role: how many decoys there are, which kind, where, with which letter and whether each harms or rewards are rolled at every scene start, see foraging.decoy_placement. They look exactly like targets and carry one letter, so only the hover name tells them apart. A decoy kind's 'injury' is the placeholder id of the death it can cause, its 'gore' the foraging.decoy_gore entry that plays when the roll made it harm; its 'zone' is kept as data but placement does not read it. The 8 decoy entries in 'placed' (2 per kind) are only the FALLBACK, used when foraging.decoy_placement is bad or its tries run out (and by the older tests); their order is where they are inserted in the plant list.

scenery._note: Scenery with no letters and nothing to forage. Positions are [x, z].

ending._note: How the scene ends. When the SIXTH word is done (any order): (1) the 고사목 at ending.dead_tree.position opens a gap, ending.exit.walk_to_x is how far uphill the travelers may then walk through it, and an exit trigger lies from trigger_from_x to walk_to_x (as wide as the gap); (2) 'note_delay_s' seconds after the word's +2 float starts, the exit note (item ending.note.item) flies in over 'flight_s' seconds and lands range_min..range_max metres from the human traveler on ground at least clear_edge m inside the walk limits, clear_plant m from every plant and pile, clear_prop m from every prop box and clear_tree m from the 고사목; tries is how many random draws are made before the ring is scanned. If the ring has no such ground at all (a traveler cornered behind firs) the same test is made again with the smaller 'relaxed' clearances; only if that fails too does the note land in the open. The flutter is sway (m, Hz), spin (degrees per second, dying away), bob (m, Hz) and flutter (degrees of tilt), all scaled by an envelope that falls to 0 at landing; start_margin is how far right of the view's edge it starts and start_height how far above its landing spot; retarget_min_s is the shortest re-aim when the traveler walks out of range mid-flight; rest_lift is its height above the ground when lying. size is the paper in metres and color its rgb. pickup_text floats up when it is taken. (3) When the human traveler enters the trigger, input is blocked and the screen fades to black over fade_s seconds; the backpack and hearts are then stored as GameState's pending bank, together with 'next'. A scene id in scene_paths is built; one that is missing there (or whose file does not exist) holds on black with hold_text (%s = the id) in the corner. Esc opens the pause menu over the black. Placeholder numbers and text.
